# Reproducible AI API availability and latency methodology

> A machine-readable reference for preserving raw observations before publishing aggregate claims.

## Gemini 4 Carbon launch (checked 2026-11-11)

AIFast [announced the listing](https://www.aifast.hk/api/announcements) of `gemini-4-carbon` on 2026-11-11. The [public catalog](https://www.aifast.hk/api/pricing) marks it `available: true`, lists `gemini` and `openai` endpoint types, and includes groups `Aistudio-Gemini-2/3/4` and `Vertex-Gemini-2/3`. OpenAI-compatible Base URL: `https://www.aifast.hk/v1`.

This entry records the launch announcement and catalog check only. No authenticated inference request was run; it supplies no Carbon success rate, latency, stability benchmark or SLA. Streaming and tool calls need separate validation.

[Current model catalog](https://www.aifast.hk/pricing) · [Gemini integration guide](https://docs.aifast.hk/en/providers/gemini-api/) · [Check a gateway with a temporary, low-limit key](https://docs.aifast.hk/model-check/)

## Gemini 4 Argon launch (checked 2026-10-15)

AIFast [announced the listing](https://www.aifast.hk/api/status) of `gemini-4-argon` on 2026-10-14. The current [catalog](https://www.aifast.hk/pricing) marks it `available: true` and lists `gemini` and `openai` protocols. The OpenAI-compatible Base URL is `https://www.aifast.hk/v1`.

[Google's model documentation](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models/gemini-4-argon) describes Argon as a flagship reasoning model for complex software engineering, mathematics, science and multi-step agents. Its 1,048,576-token unified context budget is shared by input, thinking and output. This is not a promise of 1M output through the gateway; Google's long decode requires a dedicated workflow.

This is listing and catalog evidence, not an inference test or stability benchmark. No authenticated inference request was run for this update, and it supplies no Argon success rate, latency result or long-term SLA. Check the current console for pricing and limits, then test protocol features independently.

[Check an existing gateway with a temporary, low-limit key](https://docs.aifast.hk/model-check/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=repository&utm_campaign=gemini-4-argon-launch&utm_content=stability-llms-full), then validate text, streaming and tools from your deployment network.

## Observation schema

Each JSONL row requires:

- `timestamp`: ISO 8601 UTC time;
- `model_id`: exact requested model ID;
- `test_region`: reproducible deployment region;
- `network`: carrier, cloud egress or test-network label;
- `status`: HTTP status under a documented network-failure rule;
- `elapsed_ms`: end-to-end latency;
- `request_feature`: text, stream, tools, image or another isolated capability.

Request ID, time to first byte, input size, output tokens and retry count are useful optional fields. Redact internal identifiers before publication.

## Summary fields

`tools/summarize_results.py` returns:

- valid sample count;
- HTTP 2xx success rate;
- P50 and P95 using linear interpolation;
- HTTP status-code distribution.

An average alone hides tail latency. An external report should include sample count, P50, P95, status distribution, observation window and failure definition.

## Measurement design

1. Hold model, parameters, input and network constant.
2. Separate peak and off-peak windows.
3. Split text, streaming, tool calls and media generation.
4. Record retries, cold starts and known maintenance windows.
5. Rebuild baselines after endpoint, route or model-version changes.

## Interpretation boundary

A product availability figure, a test-window success rate and a contractual SLA are different claims. AIFast's published 99% model-availability figure is first-party product data. The bundled JSONL is synthetic and must not be presented as production monitoring or an SLA measurement.

The model checker at https://docs.aifast.hk/model-check/ provides protocol and behavior snapshots. Repeated checker reports can reveal drift, but they do not replace request-window statistics or prove vendor identity.
